entry.title: Voices of Change: Councilwoman (2019, NR) Conversation

media:group.media:title: Voices of Change: Councilwoman (2019, NR) Conversation
media:group.media:description:
Join us for the inspiring story of Carmen Castillo, an immigrant Dominican in Providence, Rhode Island who wins a seat on City Council, taking her advocacy for low-income workers from the margins to city politics while balancing her day job as a hotel housekeeper. Followed by a conversation with Longmont Mayor Susie Hidalgo-Fahring & Boulder County Commissioner Marta Loachamin. Co-presented with the Longmont Multicultural Action Committee.

media:group.media:title: Comfy Couch Performance Circle - September 2026
media:group.media:description:
Robby Layton hosts a night of acoustic musical and storytelling performances. Our studio will be setup in a circle so that performers can take turns in the spotlight showing off their musical, storytelling, or otherwise unplugged skills. Audience members can watch live in studio or from live from our channels! The event is BYOB. If you enjoy this event and what to see it continue you, please make a donation at the event or online.

media:group.media:title: 2026 LevelUp Longmont Esports Tournament
media:group.media:description:
Rise to the Challenge! Our second annual esports event is back–and better than ever!
This free, all-day event takes place at the Longmont Museum and welcomes all ages to celebrate friendly competition, creativity and community. Enjoy food trucks, vendor booths, video and tabletop games, outdoor activities, a chill-out zone, a racing simulator and the Quest Log—a bingo-style challenge where participants can earn points and redeem them for prizes. The festival’s featured event takes place live in the Museum’s Stewart Auditorium: a Street Fighter 6 tournament for pre-registered players ages 13 and up.
LevelUp Longmont is presented by the Longmont Public Library and the Friends of the Longmont Library in partnership with The Longmont Museum, NextLight and Longmont Public Media.
This event is not affiliated with or sponsored by Capcom.
